hotelOccupancyNotes: Rough estimate of how full downtown hotels were, as it bears on each day (within about 10 points). Each day blends 60% of the night before with 40% of that night. Nights are built from the day of the week, the season, meetings in town, the night before cruise departures and a few visitor-heavy weekends (Satchmo/White Linen, Red Dress Run, the Saints game, Ye). The August level is set to match CoStar's published August 2026 figures for the New Orleans market (43.3% for the month; 40.6% for Aug 23–29), plus about 2 points because downtown ran a few points above the metro in 2025. The total is the month's average.
